# Vision79 Digital (v79sl.com)

> Enterprise Managed IT Services, 24/7 Network Monitoring, Cloud Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity in Saint Lucia and the Eastern Caribbean.

## Overview
Vision79 Digital is an enterprise Information and Communications Technology (ICT) partner headquartered in Castries, Saint Lucia. Founded and led by Lead Systems Architect Neil Verdant (25+ years of Caribbean telecommunications and enterprise networking heritage), Vision79 Digital provides turnkey technology operations, preventative maintenance, hurricane disaster recovery failovers, and custom software engineering.

## Key Facts & SLA
- **Location**: Castries, Saint Lucia (serving Castries, Gros Islet, Rodney Bay, Vieux Fort, Soufriere, Dennery, and regional Caribbean businesses)
- **Primary Contact / Founder**: Neil Verdant
- **Phone & Emergency Support**: +1 (758) 726-0035
- **Email**: vision79slu@gmail.com
- **WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/17587260035
- **On-Site Response SLA**: Guaranteed 4-hour on-site emergency response across Saint Lucia
- **Uptime SLA**: Financially backed 99.9% uptime guarantee for managed clients
- **Languages**: English and Saint Lucian Kwéyòl (Creole)

## Core Services
1. **Managed IT Support (MSP)**: 24/7 proactive network monitoring, remote helpdesk, preventative on-site maintenance, hardware provisioning.
2. **Cybersecurity & Threat Defense**: Vulnerability assessments, endpoint detection & response (EDR), firewall audits, ransomware protection, zero-trust policies.
3. **Cloud Infrastructure & Disaster Recovery**: Microsoft 365 migrations, Google Workspace, immutable air-gapped cloud backups (RPO < 1hr, RTO < 4hr), hurricane failover architecture.
4. **Network Architecture & Hosted VoIP**: Enterprise LAN/WAN design, dual-WAN subsea failovers, structured fiber cabling, cloud-hosted PBX.
5. **Custom Software & Automation**: Purpose-built Caribbean databases, automated workflows, AI integrations, SaaS development.
6. **ICT Health Assessment**: Comprehensive 40-point infrastructure review and written 90-day remediation roadmap (EC$1,500 / 30-min discovery consultation free).
